entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Configuration binder source generator silently binds null for a nested type whose sole member is a read-only collection constructor parameter #131399
  • pwsh Get-ChildItem on Linux does not display the birth time for the CreationTime because of bug in DOTNET code #131395
  • [API Proposal]: Make DynamicallyAccessedMembers valid for Type/string collection parameters #131394
  • [wasm][RyuJIT] Checked assert 'bbNumTryBeg <= bbNumTryLast' crossgen'ing always-suspending async methods that have a try/fault region #131393
  • [aw] CI Outer-Loop Failure Scanner — Feedback reported incomplete result #131391
  • [ci-scan] Build break: NativeMemory not available in Microsoft.Bcl.Memory.Tests on net481 #131390
  • [ci-scan] Hang: System.Diagnostics.Process.Tests times out on windows-x64 NativeAOT_Libs #131389
  • [API Proposal]: Bridging generic constraints following the `UnsafeAccessor` pattern #131388
  • [ci-scan] Build break: Windows Helix work items fail on unexpanded $HELIX_PYTHONPATH in gen-debug-dump-docs post-command #131382
  • [wasm] JIT should validate that modeled helper-call return arity matches the real helper signature #131379
  • [wasm] CORINFO_HELP_CHECK_OBJ is modeled TYP_VOID in fgMorphInit but JIT_CheckObj returns Object* #131378
  • [wasm][R2R] objectalloc retargets CORINFO_HELP_UNBOX to CORINFO_HELP_UNBOX_TYPETEST without updating the call's return type #131377

Closed

  • Improve the default hash code for structs #4414
    Future

  • Task: Collect Notion export #131385
  • Airtable Schema Snapshot — Demo Workspace Base (Research Pipeline) #131381
